For evaluation, we report BLEU-{1,2,3,4} and ROUGE scores, as in prior work on SLT. As there is only one English sentence as reference for evaluation, we also report BLEURT score.

For evaluation, we report BLEU-{1,2,3,4}  and ROUGE  scores, as in prior work on SLT . As there is only one English sentence as reference for evaluation, we also report BLEURT  score, a metric that provides a measure of semantic similarity between the prediction and ground truth.

The annotation of the validation and test sets is manually verified. Specifically, the English translation and time boundaries of each video clip are proofread and corrected as needed by professional ASL interpreters.
guideline: Each annotator views the video clip and is given the original English sentence from the subtitle for reference. The annotator marks the corrected beginning and end of the sentence, and provides a corrected English translation if needed as well as the corresponding gloss sequence.
